comparison_scopes.SELF_ROLE_PRIOR: Current player vs own strictly-prior history in the exact observed role.
comparison_scopes.PEER_ROLE_PRIOR: Current player vs other players from the same team with the exact observed role, using only strictly-prior data. Each peer contributes one prior mean so players with more matches do not receive more weight.

principles: DG-AN-01 option C is approved: self-history and peer-role comparison are both retained and explicitly separated.
All baselines are strict-past by match_date; the current date and future dates never enter the reference set.
Peer-role comparison excludes the current player from the peer pool.
Peer-role reference is equal-player weighted: first calculate each peer's prior mean, then summarize those peer means.
No minimum sample threshold is invented in Analytics-01. Counts are exposed and sufficiency policy is deferred to validated decision rules.
ABOVE/BELOW/EQUAL are mathematical directions only, not good/bad performance labels.
Analytics-01 creates no score, ranking, recommendation, tactical instruction or confidence policy.
